trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks automatically. Follow the roadmap in this guide: story first, side strands before the finale, then activities, collectibles and cleanup. Sources: official description via Exophase; roadmap built from the official descriptions.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing — it unlocks as you play the campaign, nothing extra to do. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare confirms it is story-unmissable.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the campaign; it unlocks automatically at the chapter's end. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2. Automatic as the campaign progresses — no side task needed. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the campaign. After it, free roam stays open so you can clean up everything else. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic as the campaign progresses. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion via the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress after the story. You do not need literally everything — for example 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges count toward it. Track it at Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare 100% checklist guide. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: stunt jumps (130), under-bridge flights (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25). Find them at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots; track progress at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare stunt counts. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Dip into each as you explore Leonida; you do not need to master any of them. Sources: official description via Exophase; Gamemapa activity list. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some unlock as you progress. Track them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare range locations. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee. Find them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race repeatedly does not count. Race locations appear as you explore; track them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Watch your car's Rating and upgrade it at Mod Shops if you use your own car. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early on Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg — fish the marked area from a boat with a rod until you land one big enough. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and finish one game — any title counts. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, opens from Chapter 3, and runs five quests. Finish it before the final mission to be safe — whether strands stay open after the finale is not yet confirmed. Sources: official description via Exophase; Gamemapa.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, Maritime Disputes. Work through Kenton's strand (shipwrecks) and finish it before the finale to be safe — post-finale availability is not yet confirmed. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes. Finish Billy's strand before the finale to be safe — post-finale availability is not yet confirmed. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Talk to strangers marked on the map and finish their strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others all count. Finish strands before the finale to be safe. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand involves his vehicle wish list — find the requested vehicles around Leonida. Finish before the finale to be safe. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand involves the Kitty Litter labs — clear his missions before the finale to be safe. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. MISSABLE: one spot is reported missable — do every meditation before the finale. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare (18 spots); Gamemapa (missable report). Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand and take down the specific animal he asks for. Finish before the finale to be safe. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, and cards sold at pawn shops still count toward progress. Track them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this comes along the way. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up): landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and more. Track them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare counts. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges (70 are needed for 100% completion). View them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges, and clear the easy ones first. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in a quieter area with a fast car and a planned escape route. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — keep the streak going and do not let the heat drop between robberies. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — getting inside one, or scanning it with WAiNK, counts. This happens naturally through the story; check Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a plane and take off without following the airport's scripted flow. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: The description quotes Kinda hot in these Rhinos — take a Rhino tank out for a spin and cause chaos with it. The exact trigger is unconfirmed; our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and guards, strike fast and leave before the alarm. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked nearby helps. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it open, then lose the wanted level. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — drive, fly and walk every region until the map is filled in. WAiNK scans and stunt spots help reveal the map. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one operation per gang across the state. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's glass front — the classic style hint points to the old-school showroom smash. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates lanes. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train both characters' Strength to the max together. Sources: official description via Exophase; Gamemapa. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Just play criminally and the count builds up. Sources: official description via Exophase; Gamemapa. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — retry something that failed once and succeed on the second attempt. The exact trigger is unconfirmed; our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a hidden trophy tied to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is unconfirmed; our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock targets down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is unconfirmed; our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game. Source: official description via Exophase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from heists and launder them steadily through your contacts. Source: official description via Exophase. Our advice is from the description only, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything counts. It adds up naturally as you play. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties via the Vice City Real Estate phone app (about $160,000 total): Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue $12,000; Vela Rota Drive $24,000; Persistence Road $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court $34,000; Atlantic Court $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare prices. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you drive at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — you need free parking spots, so buy garages first. Sources: official description via Exophase; PushSquare. Not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
